name: AI Form Guard
description: Extends AI Webform Guard to protect custom forms from spam using AI detection.
project_description: AI Form Guard is a submodule of AI Webform Guard that extends the same AI-powered spam detection engine to arbitrary custom (non-Webform) Drupal forms. It adds a 'Custom Form IDs' textarea to the parent module's settings form (one form id per line, e.g. contact_form, user_register_form); any listed form is spam-checked on submit via hook_form_alter() using the shared SpamDetectionService. A dedicated 'AI Custom Form Fields' page lets you exclude fields and set a per-form custom prompt. It reuses the parent module's AI model, prompt, flood control, whitelist, and human-iteration settings; only the custom form id list and per-form field settings are its own.
